summary: A top MP fills all 13 implant slots with CONTROL-Unit symbiants - the nano/pet-caster unit (the Control line is profession-locked to Engineer, Trader, Bureaucrat and Meta-Physicist; verified stat-60 lock {3,7,8,12} in items.ocp, and both the ao-universe and Funcom guides put MP in the Control unit). Control symbiants stack the six nano schools (Matter Creation, Time & Space, Bio Met, Matter Met, Psycho Mod, Sensory Impr) plus Nano Pool, Max Nano, Nano Init, Treatment and Nano Resist - exactly the caster/pet stats an MP wants, which is why symbiants outclass cluster implants here. Best-in-slot at endgame is the Xan Control-Unit ALPHA in every slot (highest bonuses of the line: e.g. all six nano schools +144 and +574 Max Nano on the Brain/Head Alpha). Progression to reach them: wear the Xan Control Beta first (lower reqs), then swap each slot to the crafted Alpha once Treatment/Int/Psychic/level allow.

unitChoice.why: Control is the caster/pet unit shared by MP/Crat/Engi/Trader; it carries the nano-school + nano-pool + nano-init bonuses an MP lives on. Verified: every Control symbiant's ToWear action profession-locks to stat 60 EqualTo {3 Engineer, 7 Trader, 8 Bureaucrat, 12 Meta-Physicist} (items.ocp).
unitChoice.note: The ao-universe symbiant guide lists Control, Extermination and Support as MP-usable; Control is the nano-caster pick used here. Extermination/Support trade nano bonuses for other stats and are not best-in-slot for a caster MP.

alphaCrafting.what: Xan Alpha symbiants are the most advanced symbiants in AO. They cannot be looted - each is crafted by the player from two QL300 components and is NODROP / cannot be reverted once assembled.
alphaCrafting.recipe: Combine (drag + shift-click, or the tradeskill window) a Xan <slot> Symbiant, Control Unit Beta with an Intelligent <slot> Symbiant, Control Unit Aban QL300 of the SAME slot and unit. No tradeskill tool or nano is required.

components.xanBeta: Xan Control-Unit Beta for the slot. Betas drop from the 3 Legacy-of-the-Xan instances; the Ear and Thigh Betas instead come from separate quests (Arid Rift / Neretva) and are NODROP.
components.intelligentQL300: Intelligent Control-Unit (Aban) QL300 for the slot - the top-QL Shadowlands pocket-boss symbiant. The QL300 Intelligent tier drops from The Night Heart on the Pandemonium islands (real or instanced). Tradeable (YESDROP).

assembleRequirements.note: Skill needed to perform the combine (ao-universe Alpha-symbiant tradeskill guide).
assembleRequirements.abilityRule: Three abilities: two fixed by unit + one variable by slot. For Control the two fixed are Intelligence + Psychic.

equipRequirements.note: Requirements to WEAR the finished Control Alpha, read from items.ocp ToWear (identical across all 13 slots except the one variable ability).
equipRequirements.variableAbilityBySlot: third equip ability is Agility (Head/Ear/Waist/Thigh), Sense (Eye/LeftArm/LeftWrist/Feet), Stamina (Chest/LeftHand) or Strength (RightArm/RightHand/RightWrist), each 1276

alphaCrafting.clickyTrick: Xan Beta Ear and Thigh are clickable: right-click cycles their unit type. Buy the cheapest Intelligent Ear/Thigh of any unit, cycle the Beta to match, combine, then cycle the resulting Alpha back to Control. (Funcom guide.)
alphaCrafting.upgradeOverBase: Per slot the Alpha beats both components. Head example: Beta nano-schools +130 / Max Nano +519; Intelligent (SL QL300) +137 / +547; Alpha +144 / +574. Alpha is a straight upgrade of the QL300 SL symbiant, with the same equip reqs.

xanAlphaNote: Endgame path: Shadowlands Control symbiants (top tier = 'Intelligent', QL300) are the base; the Legacy-of-the-Xan 'Xan ... Beta' symbiants are a lower-req stepping stone; the crafted 'Xan ... Alpha' (Beta + Intelligent QL300) is best-in-slot. Alpha and the Ear/Thigh Betas are NODROP - build the Alpha on the MP that will wear it.

_verification.namesAndIds: All 39 ids (13 Intelligent + 13 Beta + 13 Alpha) verified in itemnames.sql; each row's symbiant name matched to its slot programmatically.
_verification.statsAndReqs: QL, keyBonuses and reqs extracted from items.ocp (OMNICELL-CONTENT v3) with tools/mp-symbiant-extractor; stat numbers mapped from AOSharp.Common Stat.cs; ToWear = equip reqs, funcType 53045 (target=wearer) = stat bonuses.
_verification.professionLock: Control unit ToWear stat-60 EqualTo {3,7,8,12} => Engineer/Trader/Bureaucrat/Metaphysicist.

_unverified: Exact drop tables / which specific pocket boss drops each non-QL300 Control symbiant tier are from the guides (ao-universe points to TinkerPocket at ao.tinkeringidiot.com), not re-verified item-by-item here.

The ao-universe main symbiants guide did not give per-slot MP picks (it defers to TinkerPocket); the per-slot Control choice here is derived from the verified Control-unit profession lock + the Xan/Alpha guides + extracted stats.

keyBonuses list only the MP-relevant (nano/caster/survival) subset of each symbiant's full modifier set; each also grants many weapon/utility skills omitted here (full per-item dumps in tools/mp-symbiant-extractor output).
'assembleRequirements.abilitiesTotal 1276' is the ao-universe crafting-guide figure; the extracted per-ability EQUIP reqs are 1276 each (Int, Psychic + variable) - crafting vs wearing reqs differ.
